title: Dream at Dionysiou: 1800s Paris brothel, the Virgin Mary and Harry Haller
summary: Ralph tells of Dream at Dionysiou: 1800s Paris brothel, the Virgin Mary and Harry Haller, about 1991 (dream set in the 1800s) at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Dionysiou monastery, Mount Athos, Greece; dream set in Paris

tellings.quote: I just walking down these 18th century Paris streets and I'm walking in the brothel. >> Yeah. >> I just want to see what's going on. That's kind of a typical me thing. And And that's when I encounter what turned out to be the Virgin Mary.

plain: A man named Ralph says that around 1991, while staying at Dionysiou, a monastery on Mount Athos in Greece, he had a vivid dream set in old Paris. In the dream he walked down the old streets and into a brothel just to see what was going on, and there he met a figure who turned out to be the Virgin Mary. He connects it to Harry Haller, the main character of the novel Steppenwolf, and tells it as a sign that dreams can reach beyond ordinary time and place.
